title: Calling up Starlink customer service? You'll be talking to Grok.
key_facts: This week SpaceX announced a new Grok Voice model and said Starlink call centres already use it to answer 20,000 customer calls a day.
SpaceX said roughly 70% of those calls are resolved without humans.
Grok Voice agents verify customers, troubleshoot Starlink hardware, issue credits and ship replacement equipment, in multiple languages.
SpaceX says Starlink serves more than 6 million active customers worldwide.
SpaceX did not respond to Business Insider's questions about which languages Grok supports or what types of calls still require a person.
In July OpenAI released GPT-Live-1 with call-capable support; Google has launched similar enterprise systems; Meta's Muse can handle phone calls for beta users.
